caption:
Your shower curtain keeps clinging to your leg.

Hot water creates a draft of steam inside the shower, and a light liner with no weight at the bottom gets pulled right into that airflow. With nothing anchoring the hem, it swings in and sticks to wet skin instead of hanging flat.

This liner has magnets sewn along the bottom edge and twelve button holes across the top, so it hangs weighted and secured instead of floating around. It's rated 4.6 stars by about seventy thousand people.

The curtain stays against the tub wall, the water stays inside the tub, and it's about $9.
